learning_outcomes.text: Students know the classification of machine tools by process, flexibility, productivity, and degree of automation.
They understand the requirements for machine tools and their associated construction.
They master the most important basics for selecting machines and systems from the perspective of quality, cost, flexibility, and productivity.
Students know important quality problems of machine tools.

syllabus_topics: Properties of machine tools under static, dynamic, and thermal load
Application areas of various machine tools
Components of machine tools (frames, guides, and bearings)

assessment_methods.method: Successful participation in the laboratory (ungraded academic achievement)
Written exam (60 min) or project work (type of examination will be determined at the beginning of the semester)

assessment_rules: Successful participation in the laboratory is an ungraded academic achievement and a prerequisite for receiving credit points. The module examination must be passed. The type of examination (written exam or project work) will be specified at the beginning of the semester.
